report_topic: Performance Audit on Public Health Infrastructure and Management of Health Services in Goa
observations_summary: The audit found significant human resource shortages, infrastructure gaps including dilapidated buildings and non-functional facilities, delays and quality control issues in drug and equipment procurement, and under-utilization of funds for health infrastructure and centrally sponsored schemes. Regulatory mechanisms were also found to be weak, with delays in enacting acts, insufficient inspections, and poor bio-medical waste management.
